get.description: Retrieves the fields allowed in blueprint and transition criteria for the specified module and layout. Use this before building blueprint or transition criteria rules. Available pre-defined values include @${EMPTY}@, @${NOTEMPTY}@, @${OPEN}@, @${CLOSED}@, and @${CURRENTTIME}@. Available field types are @Text@, @Date@, @DateTime@, @Boolean@, and @Arithmetic@.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Module for which criteria fields must be retrieved. Required. Currently supported value: @tickets@.

schema.description: Module for which criteria fields must be retrieved. Required. Currently supported value: @tickets@.

parameters.name: layoutId
parameters.description: Unique ID of the layout for which criteria fields must be retrieved. Required.

schema.description: Unique ID of the layout for which criteria fields must be retrieved. Required.

get.description: Retrieves the field details that can be configured in blueprints for the specified layout and module. Use this before creating or editing a blueprint to discover which ticket fields can be mapped to the blueprint workflow.

parameters.name: layoutId
parameters.description: Unique ID of the layout for which fields must be retrieved. Required.

schema.description: Unique ID of the layout for which fields must be retrieved. Required.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Module for which fields must be retrieved. Required. Currently supported value: @tickets@.

schema.description: Module for which fields must be retrieved. Required. Currently supported value: @tickets@.

getBlueprintsCriteriaFieldsResponse.description: Returns groups of fields available for blueprint and transition criteria, including supported conditions and values for each field.

criteriaFields.description: Groups of fields available for building blueprint or transition criteria rules. Type: array of objects. Required in response.

displayLabel.description: Human-readable label of the field group shown in the UI. Type: string, max 250 characters. Required. Example: "Tickets".

name.description: API name of the field group used in criteria expressions. Type: string, max 250 characters. Required. Example: "tickets".

condition.description: Machine-readable condition identifier. Type: string, max 250 characters. Required. Example: "is".

i18NCondition.description: Localized display label for the condition. Type: string, max 250 characters. Required. Example: "is".

value.description: Allowed value placeholders or literals for this condition. Type: array of strings or nested arrays. Required. Examples: ["${CUSTOM}"], ["${EMPTY}"].

availableConditions.description: Conditions supported for this field in criteria rules. Type: array of objects. Required in each fieldDetails entry.

fieldLabel.description: Display label of the criteria field. Type: string, max 250 characters. Required. Example: "Account Name".

i18NLabel.description: Internationalized display label of the criteria field. Type: string, max 250 characters. Required. Example: "Account Name".

type.description: Data type of the field used to determine valid criteria operators. Type: string, max 250 characters. Required. Examples: lookup, Text, Date, Boolean.

fieldDetails.description: List of individual fields within the group, each with supported conditions and values. Type: array of objects. Required.

getBlueprintFieldsToConfigureResponse.description: Returns a list of ticket fields that can be configured in blueprints for the specified layout, including display labels, field types, and allowed values.

fields.description: List of ticket fields that can be configured in blueprints for the specified layout. Type: array of objects. Required in response.
